note: The three required findings of the initial review round (T027), held here as a durable copy because the packet itself is untracked build output. The verification round (T028) passes this file to build_prompt.py through DR_PRIOR_FINDINGS so the reviewer judges fresh captures against the original acceptance criteria. Source: notes/design-review.md 'Findings and dispositions' and review-initial/merged.json.

required.title: Control and menu hint text is unreadably small
required.region: left panel control hints (x=52..324) and the title, pause, and game-over footer hint lines
required.observed_problem: The gameplay control hints and the menu footer hints draw at glyph scale 1, so their text is 7 logical px tall while panel labels run at 14 px and menu items at 21 px. In the letterboxed 640x480 frame the same rows measure 4 to 5 device pixels.
required.player_effect: The player cannot read the control hints while learning the game, especially in a smaller desktop window.
required.acceptance_criteria: T030 raised every hint line to the 14 px label height and T028 verified it. Task T037 (approved 2026-11-03) later removed the permanent gameplay legend outright: ordinary gameplay carries no control hints, and the menu footer hints stay at the 14 px scale. On a fresh packet tools/design-review/check_fixes.py passes focused-hud-stats-left (seven statistics rows, no legend below them, quiet gaps) instead of control-hint-glyph-scale.
required.superseded: The gameplay-hint portion is superseded by the approved focused HUD of task T037; the menu footer hint scale of T030 still holds. Do not report the missing gameplay legend as a defect.

required.title: Ghost outline contrast against the well is below 3:1
required.region: ghost outline of the active piece over the board well
required.observed_problem: The ghost is a one-pixel outline in a color blended 60 percent toward the well, so the landing preview is the weakest shape on the board: outline (35, 91, 53) against the well (10, 12, 19) measures a 2.44:1 luminance contrast while the active piece fill reaches about 9.8:1.
required.player_effect: The landing position is hard to read at a glance, which slows aiming.
required.acceptance_criteria: At least 3:1 luminance contrast against the well with the outline still hollow and distinct from settled and active cells, inside the approved 'same piece outline or dim fill'. tools/design-review/check_fixes.py passes ghost-outline-contrast on a fresh packet.

required.title: Letterboxed scene anchors at the top of a resized window
required.observed_problem: In the 640x480 window the scene scales by two thirds but anchors at the top of the window: 0 px of bar above and 118 px below. A 720x480 probe showed 0 px above and 72 px below. SDL_RenderSetLogicalSize runs once at startup, so a later resize never recenters the viewport.
required.player_effect: A resized desktop window shows the game stuck to the top edge with dead space below, instead of a centered picture.
required.acceptance_criteria: Both letterbox bars exist and differ by at most 2 px; native 960x544 output is unchanged. tools/design-review/check_fixes.py passes letterbox-scene-centered on a fresh packet.

not_required.reason: The dim signal works (stashed piece at 0.77 of preview brightness, verified in T024) and a LOCKED label would add words the panel does not need. Deferred with the reviewer's own optional_cosmetic classification; it does not gate T028.

not_required.disposition: decided and implemented by task T029 on 2026-11-03
not_required.reason: The design owner approved immediate spawn visibility: every piece now spawns with its topmost occupied cells at visible row 0 (I matrix origin y=-1, all others y=0), so the hidden I-piece interval no longer occurs. See notes/stackfall-visible-spawn-decision-2026-11-03.md and the T029 section of notes/agent-testing.md. Do not report immediate spawn visibility as a defect.
